# 📦 Release Notes

> ⚠️ **Flash at your own risk**

> ⚠️ Only **Android 17** ROMs

---

## Features
- **KernelSU Next** legacy v3.4.2 (spoofed) / **BakaSU** Latest
- **SUSFS** v2.3.0
- **BORE** Scheduler
- **Droidspaces** Support
- **BBR** Congestion algorithm
- **FQ** Fair Queue Scheduling
- **250Hz** Kernel timer interrupt frequency
- **LZO** Compression algorithm
- **KernelSU Module** for device tweaks
---

## Build Types
- [KernelSU Next](https://github.com/Gamesmes90/KernelSU-Next/tree/legacy-susfs) with [manual hook](https://kernelsu-next.github.io/webpage/pages/how-to-integrate-for-non-gki.html#manually-modify-the-kernel-source) (``ksun``)
- [BakaSU](https://github.com/Baka-SU/BakaSU)
  - with [manual hook](https://bakasu.org/guide/build#manual-hooks) (``bakasu``)
  - with [SUSFS inline hook](https://bakasu.org/guide/build#susfs) (``bakasu_susfs-inline-hook``)

## 📝 Flashing instructions
* Backup **vendor_boot.img**, **vendor_dlkm.img**, and **boot.img** before flashing
* Flash the AK3 zip file with a kernel flasher app or in recovery with ``adb sideload [kernel.zip]``
* Check for updates with the KernelSU module action button (Kernel Tweaks)

---
